bibliographic.title: Rise of the Necropolis
bibliographic.author: Noelle Correa and Amiel Cox
bibliographic.description: "The long dead necromancer-king Osiris has been brought back into the world of the living and has been raising his undead armies of ancient Necropolis soldiers for a few days by now. These unholy footmen were the once proud legions of the forgotten nation of Abydos, long lost to the sands of time. Osiris wishes to turn the entire world into sand and dust, just like his own kingdom was. Now make haste to the south. Every second Osiris gets stronger. I have gathered a party of warriors and mages for you in the courtyard. Make sure to ask them to follow you so they know you need them. Good luck Sir Louen."
